data.name: LocalFirstDescription
data.value: CareNest works without an account. Records stay in this app’s local storage in the current release. There is no automatic cloud upload.

data.name: BackupResponsibility
data.value: You are responsible for keeping useful encrypted backups and protecting exported copies.

data.name: MedicalDisclaimer
data.value: CareNest is an organizational tool only. It does not diagnose conditions, determine dosage, recommend treatment, replace a doctor or pharmacist, or provide emergency services. Follow instructions from qualified professionals.

data.name: ReminderLimitations
data.value: Reminder delivery can be affected by permissions, battery optimization, device shutdown, time-zone changes, and operating-system restrictions. In an emergency, contact local emergency services instead of relying on CareNest.
